Application.name: OpenAI Terrain Reconstruction
Application.desc: Urubah Terrain After reconstructed from the combined bound LIT-EXW drawings 10401-10414. Parsed 1632 numeric elevation MText labels from the CAD blocks; 1557 unique XY controls were retained after removing 75 exact duplicate tile/XREF labels, with no conflicting duplicate elevations. Non-numeric annotations such as [No Slope] were excluded. No separate park-boundary DXF was supplied, so a concave control-point envelope was reconstructed from the elevation distribution; its source envelope is 756823 m², close to the drawing legend total plot area of 754643 m². Original elevation controls are preserved exactly, the envelope is sampled every 5 m, and the interior is densified every 8 m by linear interpolation.
